sep_value_slice.name: sep_value_slice
sep_value_slice.note: Presented as removing a branch that duplicates the fallthrough in short-option chaining; '-a=0' now yields the value '=0'.

long_lastsep.name: long_lastsep
long_lastsep.note: Presented as scanning long options for the separator from the end; '--string=k=v' now splits at the last '=' and is rejected as an unknown option. No upstream test has a separator inside a long option's value.

inline_chaining.name: inline_chaining
inline_chaining.note: Presented as letting LLVM fold the chaining state machine into its callers; it duplicates the function at both call sites instead.
